criteria.text: The README "OpenSandbox cells" section lists the evidence push as a numbered step before `OPENSANDBOX_URL`, and the renewal rule.
The timer runs on the box, pushes fresh evidence, and the newest evidence's `expires_at` moves forward (shown by a read-only query).
The timer skips (and logs why) when a cell run is live.
With evidence expiring within 7 days, the alert fires once (no duplicate issue while one is open); with fresh evidence it does not.
No secret appears in the timer's journal or the alert.
